checks.criterion: 1. Tests written and run failing first; independent Jones-vector oracle.
checks.evidence: pipeline/tests/polarimetry/hybrid_oracle.py:43–100 independently computes transmitted and received fields without importing production code. The test file exists, but failing-first execution cannot be established from source; checks were prohibited.

checks.criterion: 2. Required transmit ellipticity, recorded handedness, and F6 agreement for both ellipticities.
checks.evidence: polarimetry.py:2214 validates ellipticity; :2343 requires chi_tx; :2407 records handedness. test_polarimetry_mchi.py:241–285 asserts F6 powers and Stokes identities for both ellipticities. Numerical execution was prohibited by the read-only restriction.

checks.criterion: 3. Correct m and chi formulas, unpolarized unavailability, and invalid Stokes handling.
checks.evidence: polarimetry.py:2498–2536 implements physicality checks, m, and M_ZERO unavailability. test_polarimetry_mchi.py:713–859 covers fully polarized scatterers, the 2x2 identity covariance, nonpositive S1, and nonphysical polarization. Execution was prohibited by the read-only restriction.

checks.criterion: 4. Decomposition deferred unless sourced formulas are implemented.
checks.evidence: polarimetry.py:2566 explicitly records the decomposition as not implemented and deferred. MChi fields at :2445–2452 and return paths at :2615 and :2640 contain polarization/ellipticity results and metadata, with no bounce components.

checks.criterion: 5. Lunar sign helper reports fractions and strict-majority verdicts without flipping data.
checks.evidence: polarimetry.py:2672 uses strict integer majorities; :2778–2806 computes fractions and returns a verdict without modifying inputs. test_polarimetry_mchi.py:1077–1124 covers 95 percent CPR 0.5, negated S4, unchanged inputs, and the half boundary. Execution was prohibited by the read-only restriction.

checks.criterion: 6. Observables carry role='context'; no cross-band comparison added.
checks.evidence: polarimetry.py:2231 rejects other roles. HybridStokes and MChi default to context at :2293 and :2452 and validate it at :2315 and :2471. Inspection of the complete diff found no cross-band comparison function.
